purpose: Gold-standard CORRECT state for the Cloudflare Pages fixture (_headers/_redirects platform traps).

checks.desc: _headers must NOT send X-Robots-Tag: noindex site-wide
_redirects resolves in one hop, 301 for permanent moves (no 302)
Unique title + meta description per page
Absolute canonical per page
Internal links point to final URLs (not redirected legacy paths)
robots.txt allows desired AI crawlers (GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot) consistent with GEO goal
/llms.txt present
/ai-agents.json present
sitemap.xml exists + Sitemap: line in robots.txt
AI-readable primary-answer summaries on docs pages
Organization with stable @id
TechArticle/Article schema on docs pages
BreadcrumbList for docs hierarchy
WebSite schema linked to Organization @id
FAQPage where Q&A content exists
_headers sets long-TTL immutable Cache-Control for static assets
Third-party analytics deferred (not render-blocking in <head>)
Optimized images with dimensions (WebP/AVIF, Cloudflare Polish-aware)
Security headers present (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy)
Early Hints / preload for critical assets (Cloudflare-native)

scoring.note: Each category has 5 checks x 5 pts = 25. Full points when detected AND correct action; half when detected only; zero when missed.
